#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
typedef long long ll;

struct FieldMod {
    int v;
    FieldMod(ll x = 0) : v(x % MOD) { if (v < 0) v += MOD; }
    FieldMod operator+(const FieldMod& o) const { return FieldMod(v + o.v); }
    FieldMod operator*(const FieldMod& o) const { return FieldMod((ll)v * o.v); }
    FieldMod& operator+=(const FieldMod& o) { v = (v + o.v) % MOD; return *this; }
    FieldMod& operator*=(const FieldMod& o) { v = (ll)v * o.v % MOD; return *this; }
    FieldMod operator/(int d) const { return *this * FieldMod(pow_mod(d, MOD-2)); }
    static ll pow_mod(ll a, ll e) { ll r=1; while(e) { if(e&1) r=r*a%MOD; a=a*a%MOD; e>>=1; } return r; }
};

constexpr int S = 128;
struct BitsetHash {
    size_t operator()(const bitset<S>& b) const {
        return hash<string>()(b.to_string());
    }
};

public:
    void solve(istream& cin, ostream& cout) {
        int N; cin >> N;
        vector<vector<int>> P(N, vector<int>(N));
        for (int i=0; i<N; ++i) for (int j=0; j<N; ++j) cin >> P[i][j];

        unordered_map<bitset<S>, FieldMod, BitsetHash> G;
        bitset<S> start; start[0] = 1;
        G[start] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            unordered_map<bitset<S>, FieldMod, BitsetHash> H;
            for (auto& g : G) {
                bitset<S> cur = g.first;
                for (int m = 0; m < (1<<N); ++m) {
                    if (cur[m]) {
                        // We'll process later, just store the state as vector of ints? Actually we need to iterate over all m.
                        // But we can directly use the bitset in the inner loop.
                    }
                }
                // Instead, we'll convert to vector<int> as original, but using bitset iteration.
                vector<int> Slist;
                for (int m = 0; m < (1<<N); ++m) if (cur[m]) Slist.push_back(m);
                H[bitset<S>()] = g.second; // dummy, we need to store Slist as key? Actually we need to map from vector<int> to FieldMod.
                // Let's just do the original conversion but using unordered_map with vector<int> key.
            }
            // Actually we need to restructure. Let's do it properly.
            // We'll use map<vector<int>, FieldMod> as original but with unordered_map.
            unordered_map<vector<int>, FieldMod> H;
            for (auto& g : G) {
                vector<int> Slist;
                for (int m = 0; m < (1<<N); ++m) if (g.first[m]) Slist.push_back(m);
                H[Slist] = g.second;
            }
            G.clear();
            for (int j = 0; j < (1<<N); ++j) {
                FieldMod pst = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
                    if (j & (1<<k)) pst = pst * FieldMod(P[i][k]);
                    else pst = pst * FieldMod(100 - P[i][k]);
                }
                for (auto& h : H) {
                    bitset<S> ans;
                    for (int l = 0; l < N; ++l) {
                        if ((j & (1<<l)) == 0) continue;
                        for (int m : h.first) {
                            if ((m & (1<<l)) == 0) {
                                ans[m | (1<<l)] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (ans.any()) {
                        G[ans] += h.second * pst;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        FieldMod ans = 0;
        for (auto& g : G) ans += g.second;
        for (int i = 0; i < N*N; ++i) ans = ans / 100;
        cout << ans.v << endl;
    }

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(nullptr);

    solver.solve(cin, cout);
    return 0;
